m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Pitter Daybreeze? Oh, no... young Wizard. Can't help you there. He departed a while ago. Headed over to Krokotopia. You should go ask about him there.

He's likely working out at the Oasis. You could always ask one of the Manders there... I think he may be working for the Athame vendor, Keiser Hal'am. Pitter kept muttering something about the slow knife...
Welcome to my shop! How can I help you today?

Pitter Daybreeze? I am afraid that I cannot be of much assistance in that matter. Mr. Daybreeze only worked in my shop for a brief time. He found that the desert climate was too much for him... he kept complaining about the dunes.
I suspect he met his fate in Dragonspyre. He found a nice tower amongst the ruins, but once the Dragon Titan's army ventured into that place, he was never heard from again.
If you seek any of his papers, you will find them amongst the ruins of Dragonspyre. Your best hope is to check the Atheneum, and ask Milos Bookwyrm there where Pitter's workshop is to be found.
Greetings, young Wizard! It's a banner day for me here... so many visits when I was forsaken for so long. What can I do for you?
Pitter Daybreeze? Now that's a name I haven't heard in quite a few years. He came here some time ago... my memory fails me as to when, and asked about a good place to set up a workshop.
I believe he settled upon the Labyrinth as his optimal destination. I'd search there... that's your best chance of finding what you're after.
Gadzooks! You've found the Pattern! I knew you could do it! Let's get to work now!
I'm crackling with anticipation for the Pattern. Have you retrieved it from Pitter Daybreeze? He works at the Storm Mill for Sohomer Sunblade, over on Triton Avenue.

Now that we've got the Component Parts, the next step is to assemble the Oscillation Overthruster. We need a specialized diagram called a Pattern for that. This is unfortunately a task beyond any I know how to do.
But don't fret! I know just the fellow who can help you! Pitter Daybreeze is his name! He's a reclusive, eccentric fellow, but very much the mental giant.

He lives on Triton Avenue, and works at the Storm Mill. I haven't spoken to him in a while, but he'll undoubtedly have the pattern we're looking for. Go and speak to Sohomer and he'll tell you where you can find Pitter Daybreeze.
